occasions: OCCASIONS
The occasions: when people consume
Each occasion is a moment of demand. Most formats serve several of them.
Morning & breakfast
The moment: Hotel breakfast, café opening, brunch.
Products: Baked goods and pastry flour, fruit preserves, mountain yogurt and butter, coffee.
Coffee & café break
The moment: The daily ritual. The highest-frequency occasion.
Products: Premium roasted coffee and espresso, artisan chocolate, small pastries.
Aperitivo & mocktail
The moment: Pre-dinner and the zero-proof happy hour.
Products: Mixology syrups and mixers, non-alcoholic aperitivi, non-alcoholic wines and beer, coffee drinks.
Dessert & sweet
The moment: Restaurant dessert, café cake, gelato.
Products: Artisan chocolate, gelato, fruit preparations, pastry.
Cheese & savory board
The moment: Cheese course and sharing boards.
Products: Aged and DOP cheese, fruit chutneys, artisan bread.
Gifting
The moment: Eid and Ramadan, plus year-round corporate.
Products: Artisan gift chocolate, preserve gift boxes, cheese hampers.
Everyday pantry
The moment: Take-home, for use at home.
Products: Retail chocolate, preserve jars, coffee bags, packaged cheese.
